mapper.select: SELECT so.order_id, so.inbound_detail_id, fp.ticker, fp.name AS name, so.sell_qty, so.base_price, ROUND(so.sell_qty * so.base_price, 2) AS order_amount, so.status, so.processed_at FROM sell_order so LEFT JOIN foreign_product fp ON fp.foreign_product_id = so.foreign_product_id WHERE so.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY so.processed_at DESC, so.order_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
